senses.en: with something as a background, for contrast
senses.pattern: against the sky / against a white background / stand out against sth
senses.example: The tall pine trees looked almost black [[against]] the orange evening sky.
senses.example_zh: 高大的松樹襯著橘紅色的傍晚天空，看起來幾乎是黑色的。

senses.en: touching, pressing on, or leaning on something
senses.pattern: lean against the wall / press sth against sth / rest against sth
senses.example: Tired after the long hike, he sat down and rested his back [[against]] a large rock.
senses.example_zh: 長途健行後很累，他坐下來，背倚著一塊大石頭休息。

senses.en: in order to protect from or prevent something
senses.pattern: protection against sth / guard against sth / a vaccine against flu / insure sth against fire
senses.example: Hikers are advised to wear long sleeves as protection [[against]] insect bites in the forest.
senses.example_zh: 建議登山客穿長袖，以預防森林裡的蚊蟲叮咬。

gsat.sentence: You might speed up healing time by gently pressing a warm washcloth [[against]] your eyelid for 10 minutes, 3 or 4 times a day.
Nature provides other forms of protection [[against]] environmental dangers.

senses.en: weapons, especially those used by an army
senses.pattern: take up arms / lay down one's arms / the arms race / arms control
senses.example: After years of fighting, the rebels finally agreed to lay down their [[arms]] and join the peace talks.
senses.example_zh: 經過多年戰鬥，叛軍終於同意放下武器，加入和平談判。
senses.note: 恆用複數；動詞 arm 為「武裝」

senses.en: a group of people who act together
senses.pattern: a band of volunteers / a small band of followers / a band of thieves
senses.example: A small [[band]] of volunteers spent the weekend cleaning up the beach after the storm.
senses.example_zh: 一小群志工花了整個週末，在暴風雨過後清理海灘。

senses.en: a thin flat strip or ring; a stripe
senses.pattern: a rubber band / a hair band / a metal band / a band of color
senses.example: The bird has a narrow white [[band]] across each wing, which makes it easy to recognize.
senses.example_zh: 這種鳥的每隻翅膀上都有一道細細的白色條紋，因此很容易辨認。

gsat.sentence: The Maasai are a semi-nomadic group in Kenya and northern Tanzania, wandering in [[bands]] and living almost entirely on the meat, blood, and milk of their herds.
Moreover, each visitor is offered the option to wear a GPS Adventure [[Band]], which allows them to keep track of each other while in the park.

senses.en: showing no feeling, understanding, or interest
senses.pattern: a blank look / a blank expression / a blank stare / go blank
senses.example: When the teacher asked about the homework, Leo just gave her a [[blank]] look and said nothing.
senses.example_zh: 老師問起作業時，里歐只是一臉茫然地看著她，什麼也沒說。
senses.note: go blank 指腦中一片空白

senses.en: to believe or accept something, especially something unlikely
senses.pattern: buy an excuse / buy sb's story / buy an explanation / I don't buy it
senses.example: The company says the price increase is necessary, but few customers are [[buying]] that explanation.
senses.example_zh: 公司說漲價是不得已的，但很少顧客相信這個說法。
senses.note: 口語用法，多用於否定句

senses.en: to gain extra time by delaying something
senses.pattern: buy time / buy sb some time / buy a few more days
senses.example: The goalkeeper pretended to be injured to [[buy]] time for his exhausted teammates.
senses.example_zh: 守門員假裝受傷，替筋疲力盡的隊友爭取時間。

senses.en: to question whether something is true, right, or legal
senses.pattern: challenge a decision / challenge an assumption / challenge a claim / challenge sb's authority
senses.example: Recent studies have [[challenged]] the long-held belief that students learn best by reading a text again and again.
senses.example_zh: 近來的研究質疑了一個長久以來的看法：學生靠反覆閱讀課文學得最好。

gsat.sentence: To [[challenge]] the current legal alcohol limit for drivers in the United States.

senses.en: a thick heavy stick; a stick for hitting a golf ball
senses.pattern: a golf club / a set of clubs / a wooden club / swing a club
senses.example: The golfer chose a heavier [[club]] for the long shot across the lake.
senses.example_zh: 那位高爾夫球選手選了一支較重的球桿，來打這記越過湖面的長桿。
senses.note: 撲克牌的「梅花」也是 clubs

senses.en: to harm or weaken something; to put it at risk
senses.pattern: compromise safety / compromise security / compromise one's health / compromise the quality of sth
senses.example: Using cheap materials to save money could [[compromise]] the safety of the entire bridge.
senses.example_zh: 為了省錢而使用廉價材料，可能會危及整座橋的安全。

senses.en: to go against your principles or lower your standards
senses.pattern: compromise one's principles / compromise one's standards / compromise one's beliefs
senses.example: The reporter refused to [[compromise]] her principles by accepting gifts from the people she wrote about.
senses.example_zh: 那位記者拒絕違背自己的原則，不肯收受報導對象的禮物。

senses.en: not friendly; showing little interest or warmth
senses.pattern: a cool reception / a cool response / be cool toward sb
senses.example: Ever since their argument, Mia has been [[cool]] toward her old friend and rarely speaks to her.
senses.example_zh: 自從那次爭吵後，米亞對老朋友一直很冷淡，很少跟她說話。

senses.en: calm; not excited, nervous, or angry
senses.pattern: stay cool / keep cool / a cool head / cool under pressure
senses.example: The pilot stayed [[cool]] during the emergency and landed the plane safely on a small airfield.
senses.example_zh: 飛行員在緊急狀況中保持冷靜，讓飛機安全降落在一座小機場。
senses.note: 名詞用法：keep / lose one's cool

senses.en: to reduce the amount, size, or cost of something
senses.pattern: cut costs / cut prices / cut jobs / cut spending
senses.example: To [[cut]] costs, the company asked its employees to hold online meetings instead of flying abroad.
senses.example_zh: 為了削減成本，公司要求員工改開線上會議，不再搭機出國。
senses.note: 名詞 cut：budget cuts 預算刪減

senses.en: to stay away from a class on purpose
senses.pattern: cut class / cut school / cut a lecture
senses.example: He was punished for [[cutting]] math class twice last week to play basketball in the park.
senses.example_zh: 他上週兩次蹺數學課去公園打籃球，因此受到處罰。
senses.note: 美式口語；亦說 skip class

senses.en: an illness of the mind or body
senses.pattern: an eating disorder / a sleep disorder / a mental disorder / a rare genetic disorder
senses.example: Her doctor said the constant tiredness was caused by a sleep [[disorder]], not by laziness.
senses.example_zh: 醫生說她持續的疲倦是睡眠障礙造成的，而不是因為懶惰。

gsat.sentence: Terrence Power, for example, complained that after his wife learned she had Wegener’s disease, an uncommon [[disorder]] of the immune system, they found it difficult to refuse testing recommended by her physician.
The soybean’s high fiber content is beneficial in preventing digestive [[disorders]].

senses.en: the soil in which plants grow
senses.pattern: a handful of earth / damp earth / cover sth with earth
senses.example: He dug a small hole, placed the seed inside, and covered it with loose [[earth]].
senses.example_zh: 他挖了一個小洞，把種子放進去，再用鬆軟的泥土蓋起來。
senses.note: 此義為不可數名詞

senses.en: the ground; land as opposed to sea or sky
senses.pattern: fall to earth / deep in the earth / the earth shook
senses.example: The [[earth]] shook for nearly a minute, and books fell off the shelves in every classroom.
senses.example_zh: 地面搖晃了將近一分鐘，每間教室的書都從書架上掉下來。
senses.note: on earth 用於疑問詞後表「究竟」

gsat.sentence: But Brahma thought neither would do because he believed humans would dig into the [[earth]] and climb every mountain, and eventually find it.
The gods suggested that they hide it deep in the [[earth]] or take it to the top of the highest mountain.

senses.en: a short conversation or argument
senses.pattern: a heated exchange / an angry exchange / a brief exchange
senses.example: After a heated [[exchange]] with the referee, the coach was ordered to leave the field.
senses.example_zh: 與裁判激烈爭吵之後，教練被命令離開球場。

senses.en: a place where shares or goods are bought and sold
senses.pattern: the stock exchange / a commodity exchange / trade on an exchange
senses.example: Trading on the stock [[exchange]] was stopped for an hour after prices dropped too quickly.
senses.example_zh: 由於股價跌得太快，證券交易所的交易暫停了一小時。
senses.note: exchange rate 指「匯率」

gsat.sentence: Churchill, however, managed to get the better of this [[exchange]].

senses.en: the person or team expected to win
senses.pattern: the favorite to win / the clear favorite / the hot favorite / the favorite for the title
senses.example: Having won her last ten matches, she is the clear [[favorite]] to take the gold medal.
senses.example_zh: 她已連贏十場比賽，顯然是最被看好的奪金熱門。
senses.note: 相反詞 underdog 不被看好者

senses.en: after or as a result of an event
senses.pattern: following the earthquake / following the announcement / following a complaint
senses.example: [[Following]] the heavy rain, several mountain roads were closed to traffic for two days.
senses.example_zh: 在大雨之後，好幾條山路封閉了兩天，禁止車輛通行。
senses.note: 比 after 正式，常見於新聞

senses.en: a group of supporters or fans
senses.pattern: a large following / a loyal following / build a following / attract a following
senses.example: The tiny bookstore has a devoted [[following]] among local students, who gather there every weekend.
senses.example_zh: 這家小書店在當地學生當中有一群死忠的擁護者，他們每個週末都聚在那裡。
senses.note: 常用單數，前面加 a

senses.en: the production of something, especially electricity or heat
senses.pattern: power generation / electricity generation / the generation of heat
senses.example: Burning coal for the [[generation]] of electricity releases large amounts of carbon dioxide into the air.
senses.example_zh: 為了產生電力而燃燒煤炭，會把大量二氧化碳排放到空氣中。
senses.note: power generation 發電；動詞 generate

senses.en: the highest level, number, or price reached
senses.pattern: a record high / an all-time high / hit a new high / reach a ten-year high
senses.example: Vegetable prices climbed to a ten-year [[high]] last month after two typhoons destroyed most of the crops.
senses.example_zh: 兩個颱風摧毀了大部分農作物後，菜價上個月攀上十年來的高點。
senses.note: a record high 歷史新高；反義 a record low

senses.en: a feeling of great happiness or excitement
senses.pattern: be on a high / a natural high / an emotional high
senses.example: The players were still on a [[high]] days after winning the national championship.
senses.example_zh: 贏得全國冠軍好幾天後，球員們仍然沉浸在興奮之中。

senses.en: secret information about an enemy; people who collect it
senses.pattern: gather intelligence / military intelligence / an intelligence agency / intelligence reports
senses.example: The general refused to attack until he had reliable [[intelligence]] about the enemy's position.
senses.example_zh: 將軍在取得敵軍位置的可靠情報之前，拒絕發動攻擊。
senses.note: 此義為不可數名詞

senses.en: a scientific rule describing how something always works
senses.pattern: the law of gravity / the laws of nature / the laws of physics / the law of supply and demand
senses.example: According to the [[law]] of gravity, anything you throw into the air must eventually come down.
senses.example_zh: 根據萬有引力定律，任何拋向空中的東西最後都一定會落下。

senses.en: a piece of land used for a particular purpose
senses.pattern: a parking lot / an empty lot / a vacant lot / a used-car lot
senses.example: The city plans to turn the empty [[lot]] behind the station into a small park.
senses.example_zh: 市政府計畫把車站後面那一塊空地改建成小公園。
senses.note: 美式用法

senses.en: a person's situation or fate in life
senses.pattern: one's lot in life / improve one's lot / be content with one's lot
senses.example: The charity has worked for decades to improve the [[lot]] of children in poor mountain villages.
senses.example_zh: 這個慈善團體數十年來致力於改善貧困山村兒童的處境。
senses.note: draw lots 抽籤（lot 指「籤」）

senses.en: to satisfy a need, demand, or standard
senses.pattern: meet a need / meet a demand / meet the requirements / meet a deadline
senses.example: Only two of the ten restaurants [[met]] the safety standards set by the health department.
senses.example_zh: 十家餐廳中只有兩家達到衛生局訂定的安全標準。
senses.note: 亦可指「支付」：meet the cost

senses.en: a sports competition, especially in swimming or track
senses.pattern: a track meet / a swim meet / a sports meet
senses.example: Our school's swim team broke two records at the regional [[meet]] last Saturday.
senses.example_zh: 我們學校的游泳隊上週六在區域比賽中打破兩項紀錄。
senses.note: 美式用法；英式多說 meeting

gsat.sentence: The fragrances at this scent shop are largely customized to [[meet]] the individual shopper’s taste.
Recently, new models have been introduced and accessories added to [[meet]] the needs of laborers working on various job sites.

senses.en: a citizen of a particular country
senses.pattern: a foreign national / a Japanese national / French nationals
senses.example: The embassy helped more than two hundred Japanese [[nationals]] leave the island before the storm arrived.
senses.example_zh: 大使館在暴風雨來襲前，協助兩百多名日本僑民離開該島。
senses.note: 常指居住在外國的某國公民

senses.en: an important position of authority, especially in government
senses.pattern: take office / hold office / run for office / leave office
senses.example: She decided to run for public [[office]] because she wanted to improve the schools in her town.
senses.example_zh: 她決定競選公職，因為她想改善鎮上的學校。
senses.note: in office 在任；take office 就職

gsat.sentence: Why did Prime Minister Ryu Matsumoto resign from [[office]]?
In 2011, a minister, Ryu Matsumoto, was forced to resign after only a week in [[office]], when a bad-tempered encounter with local officials was televised.

senses.en: to describe someone or something in a particular way
senses.pattern: paint a picture of sth / paint sb as sth / paint a gloomy picture / paint a rosy picture
senses.example: The report [[paints]] a worrying picture of how little sleep teenagers get on school nights.
senses.example_zh: 這份報告描繪出令人擔憂的景象：青少年在上學日的晚上睡得非常少。

senses.en: to imagine someone or something in your mind
senses.pattern: picture sb doing sth / picture oneself as sth / picture the scene
senses.example: I can still [[picture]] my grandmother standing at the stove, humming as she cooked.
senses.example_zh: 我至今仍能想像出奶奶站在爐子前，一邊煮飯一邊哼歌的模樣。

senses.en: a situation, or a general understanding of it
senses.pattern: the big picture / get the picture / a clear picture of sth / the overall picture
senses.example: Interviews with local farmers gave researchers a clearer [[picture]] of how the drought had affected them.
senses.example_zh: 訪談當地農民後，研究人員更清楚旱災影響他們的實際情況。

gsat.sentence: Steve’s description of the place was so vivid that I could almost [[picture]] it in my mind.

senses.en: (of a feeling or idea) to take control of someone
senses.pattern: be possessed by fear / be possessed by a desire / What possessed you to do that?
senses.example: [[Possessed]] by a sudden fear, the boy dropped his flashlight and ran out of the cave.
senses.example_zh: 男孩被突如其來的恐懼所支配，丟下手電筒跑出了洞穴。
senses.note: What possessed you…? 表驚訝責問

senses.en: easily seen; sticking out from a surface
senses.pattern: a prominent position / a prominent place / a prominent nose / prominent cheekbones
senses.example: The warning sign was hung in a [[prominent]] position so that no visitor could miss it.
senses.example_zh: 警告標誌掛在顯眼的位置，讓每位訪客都不會錯過。
senses.note: 名詞 prominence

gsat.sentence: It appears in a [[prominent]] place on Mexico’s national flag.

senses.en: to contact someone, especially by phone or email
senses.pattern: reach sb by phone / reach sb at this number / can't reach sb
senses.example: If you need help after school hours, you can [[reach]] me at this number.
senses.example_zh: 如果放學後需要幫忙，你可以撥這個號碼聯絡上我。

senses.en: the distance within which something can be touched or achieved
senses.pattern: within reach / out of reach / beyond the reach of sb / within easy reach of sth
senses.example: Keep all medicines out of the [[reach]] of young children, preferably in a locked cabinet.
senses.example_zh: 所有藥品都要放在幼童伸手可及的範圍之外，最好鎖在櫃子裡。

senses.en: to arrive at an agreement or decision after discussion
senses.pattern: reach an agreement / reach a conclusion / reach a decision / reach a compromise
senses.example: After three days of talks, the two companies finally [[reached]] an agreement on prices.
senses.example_zh: 經過三天的會談，兩家公司終於就價格達成協議。

gsat.sentence: And being a tiny country, everything in Rwanda is within [[reach]] in a few hours and the interesting spots can be explored comfortably in a couple of weeks.
After hours of discussion, our class finally [[reached]] the conclusion that we would go to Hualien for our graduation trip.

senses.en: to make yourself accept something unpleasant that cannot be changed
senses.pattern: resign oneself to sth / resign oneself to doing sth / be resigned to sth
senses.example: Knowing the injury would take months to heal, the runner [[resigned]] herself to missing the whole season.
senses.example_zh: 那位跑者知道傷勢要好幾個月才會痊癒，只好無奈接受整季缺賽的事實。
senses.note: to 為介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing

senses.en: a strong metal box with a lock for valuables
senses.pattern: a hotel safe / lock sth in a safe / open a safe / a fireproof safe
senses.example: Grandpa keeps the family's important documents in a small [[safe]] hidden behind a painting.
senses.example_zh: 爺爺把家裡的重要文件收在一個藏在畫後面的小保險箱裡。
senses.note: 複數為 safes

gsat.sentence: soon to replace coding bank [[safes]].

senses.en: to persuade someone to accept an idea or plan
senses.pattern: sell an idea to sb / sell sb on sth / sell oneself
senses.example: The student council is trying to [[sell]] the idea of a later start time to the principal.
senses.example_zh: 學生會正試著向校長推銷延後上學時間的想法。
senses.note: be sold on sth 完全接受某想法

senses.en: to be a sign that something exists or will happen
senses.pattern: signal a change / signal the end of sth / signal the start of sth / signal one's intention
senses.example: A cough that lasts for weeks may [[signal]] a more serious problem and should be checked by a doctor.
senses.example_zh: 持續數週的咳嗽可能預示更嚴重的問題，應該請醫生檢查。

gsat.sentence: Different colors are used in different industries to [[signal]] the roles of people on site.

senses.en: a liquid in which something has been dissolved
senses.pattern: a salt solution / a sugar solution / a weak solution / a solution of sth in water
senses.example: Hummingbirds can be fed with a [[solution]] made by dissolving sugar in warm water.
senses.example_zh: 蜂鳥可以用糖溶於溫水製成的溶液來餵食。
senses.note: 動詞 dissolve 溶解

senses.en: to tolerate something; to survive it without being damaged
senses.pattern: stand the test of time / stand the heat / stand the strain / can't stand the noise
senses.example: These hiking boots are built to [[stand]] years of rough use on rocky mountain trails.
senses.example_zh: 這款登山靴做工紮實，經得起在多岩山徑上多年的嚴苛使用。
senses.note: 「忍受」義多用於否定句和疑問句

senses.en: an attitude or opinion that you state firmly
senses.pattern: take a stand on sth / make a stand against sth / a firm stand / a tough stand
senses.example: The city has taken a firm [[stand]] against littering, raising the fine to six thousand dollars.
senses.example_zh: 市政府對亂丟垃圾採取堅定的立場，把罰款提高到六千元。

senses.en: to remain valid, unchanged, or in force
senses.pattern: the offer still stands / the decision stands / the record still stands
senses.example: The judges watched the video again, but their original decision still [[stands]].
senses.example_zh: 裁判又看了一次影片，但他們原先的判定仍然有效。

gsat.sentence: Artwork created by truly great artists such as Picasso and Monet will no doubt [[stand]] the test of time.

senses.en: very noticeable or unusual; attracting attention
senses.pattern: a striking difference / a striking contrast / a striking similarity / a striking feature
senses.example: There is a [[striking]] difference between the two brothers: one loves crowds, while the other avoids them.
senses.example_zh: 這對兄弟有個顯著的差異：一個喜歡人群，另一個則避之唯恐不及。
senses.note: 亦可形容外貌「出眾的」

gsat.sentence: Perhaps the most [[striking]] thing about MOOCs, many of which are being taught by professors at prestigious universities, is that they’re free.
Sax, a proponent of single-sex education, points out that keeping boys and girls separate in the classroom has yielded [[striking]] educational, social, and interpersonal benefits.

senses.en: a piece of candy; a sweet dish after a meal
senses.pattern: a bag of sweets / a packet of sweets / eat too many sweets
senses.example: The old shop on the corner sells handmade [[sweets]] in glass jars, just as it did fifty years ago.
senses.example_zh: 轉角那家老店用玻璃罐賣手工糖果，就和五十年前一樣。
senses.note: 英式用法；美式多說 candy

senses.en: kind, gentle, and thoughtful toward other people
senses.pattern: a sweet smile / a sweet old lady / It is sweet of sb to do sth
senses.example: It was [[sweet]] of you to stay after class and help me clean the art room.
senses.example_zh: 你真貼心，下課後還留下來幫我打掃美術教室。

gsat.sentence: To tell parents what [[sweets]] are less damaging to their children’s teeth.

senses.en: (of time or money) limited, with little to spare
senses.pattern: a tight schedule / a tight budget / a tight deadline / money is tight
senses.example: Money was [[tight]] that year, so the family canceled their trip and spent the holidays at home.
senses.example_zh: 那一年家裡經濟吃緊，所以全家取消旅行，在家過節。

senses.en: strictly controlled; very firm
senses.pattern: tight security / tight control / keep a tight grip on sth
senses.example: Security was [[tight]] at the stadium, with every bag checked before fans could enter.
senses.example_zh: 體育場的維安十分嚴密，球迷入場前每個包包都要檢查。
senses.note: a tight game 指比數接近的比賽

gsat.sentence: The mayor has such a [[tight]] schedule that it takes weeks to arrange an interview with her.
Steve has several meetings to attend every day; therefore, he has to work on a very [[tight]] schedule.

senses.en: the long nose of an elephant
senses.pattern: an elephant's trunk / raise its trunk / wave its trunk
senses.example: The baby elephant used its [[trunk]] to spray water over its back on the hot afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 炎熱的午後，小象用象鼻把水噴灑在自己的背上。
senses.note: 亦指人的「軀幹」及「大皮箱」

senses.en: the storage space at the back of a car
senses.pattern: open the trunk / in the trunk / put sth in the trunk / the trunk of a car
senses.example: We loaded the tents and sleeping bags into the [[trunk]] and set off for the campsite.
senses.example_zh: 我們把帳篷和睡袋裝進後車廂，然後出發前往營地。
senses.note: 美式用法；英式為 boot

gsat.sentence: I jumped out of the car, ran round to open the [[trunk]] and there inside were two red-faced and excited children.

senses.en: to be careful about something
senses.pattern: watch your step / watch your weight / watch what you say / watch your language
senses.example: Since the doctor's warning, my uncle has been [[watching]] his weight and avoiding fried food.
senses.example_zh: 自從醫生提出警告後，我叔叔就一直留意體重，不吃油炸食物。

senses.en: the act of guarding or observing someone or something carefully
senses.pattern: keep watch / keep a close watch on sb / be on the watch for sth
senses.example: Two guards kept [[watch]] over the museum's most valuable painting throughout the night.
senses.example_zh: 兩名警衛整夜看守著博物館最珍貴的畫作。
senses.note: 此義通常為不可數或單數

senses.en: a unit of length equal to three feet
senses.pattern: a few yards away / a hundred yards / a yard of cloth
senses.example: The swimmer was only a few [[yards]] from the shore when the lifeguard reached her.
senses.example_zh: 救生員趕到時，那名泳者離岸邊只有幾碼遠。
senses.note: 一碼為三英尺，約 0.91 公尺

senses.en: an area of land used for a particular kind of work
senses.pattern: a lumber yard / a rail yard / a builder's yard
senses.example: Old ships are taken apart in a large [[yard]] by the harbor, and their steel is sold for recycling.
senses.example_zh: 舊船在港邊的一座大型工場裡被拆解，鋼材則賣去回收。
senses.note: shipyard 造船廠

quiz.stem: Doctors warn that staying up late night after night can seriously ______ your immune system, making it harder for the body to fight off infections.
quiz.explain_zh: compromise＝危及、損害。連續熬夜會損害免疫系統，使身體較難抵抗感染。

quiz.stem: Although the singer has never appeared on television, she has attracted a loyal ______ of young listeners through her live shows in small coffee shops.
quiz.explain_zh: following＝追隨者（總稱）。這位歌手靠現場演出吸引了一群忠實的年輕聽眾。

quiz.stem: The plan to build a parking tower beside the park received a ______ response from residents, most of whom wanted more green space instead.
quiz.explain_zh: cool＝冷淡的。居民多半想要綠地，對興建停車塔的計畫反應冷淡。

quiz.stem: A ______ feature of the new library is its huge glass roof, which catches every visitor's eye the moment they walk through the door.
quiz.explain_zh: striking＝引人注目的。新圖書館的玻璃屋頂讓人一進門就注意到。

quiz.stem: The newly elected president will take ______ in January, and she has promised to make clean energy her top priority.
quiz.explain_zh: office＝公職；take office 就職。新當選的總統將於一月就職，並承諾優先發展潔淨能源。

quiz.stem: In the lab class, we were told to soak the onion skin in a weak salt ______ for five minutes before placing it under the microscope.
quiz.explain_zh: solution＝溶液。實驗課要先把洋蔥表皮泡在稀食鹽溶液中五分鐘。

quiz.stem: After missing the last train, the two backpackers ______ themselves to sleeping on a bench at the station until morning.
quiz.explain_zh: resign＝使無奈接受。錯過末班車的背包客只好認命在車站長椅過夜。

quiz.stem: Kevin claimed that his dog had eaten his report, but the teacher didn't ______ his story and asked him to hand it in the next day.
quiz.explain_zh: buy＝相信（說法）。老師不相信凱文「狗吃了報告」的說詞。

quiz.stem: In many parts of Asia, the first call of this migratory bird is believed to ______ the end of winter and the beginning of the planting season.
quiz.explain_zh: signal＝預示。這種候鳥的第一聲鳴叫被認為預示冬天結束、播種季開始。

quiz.stem: Thanks to the popular night market, the number of tourists visiting the old town reached a record ______ of two million last year.
quiz.explain_zh: high＝高點、最高水準。老城區的遊客人數去年創下兩百萬的歷史新高。
